#summary Explains how to get started with code-o-matic.

= Instroduction =

This page contains walkthrough steps that will get you started with code-o-matic.

Before you start, you need to install [http://www.postsharp.org/ Postsharp] on your development machine.

= Using the validation library =

  # Install the validation plug-in by running *CodeOMatic.Validation.Installer.msi*.
  # Open your project.
  # Add references to the following assemblies (in C:\Program Files\PostSharp 1.0):
    * PostSharp.Core.dll
    * PostSharp.Public.dll
  # Add references to the following assemblies (from code-o-matic):
    * CodeOMatic.Validation.dll
    * CodeOMatic.Validation.Core.dll
  # Apply validation attributes to your method and properties, as described in   ValidationExamples.
